title: Parallel units refused each other
what_happened: A unit's red check failed on another queued unit's red tests, so only one unit could wait and the clock idled.
lesson: Red check, build check and landing tolerate the exact red tests of other units still in the queue.

title: A stopped unit blocked everyone
what_happened: A unit stopped with its red tests in place, and every other unit's checks failed on them.
lesson: Tolerate a stopped unit's tests while its stop card is open; retry an errored review once.

title: Units cut before a landing could not land
what_happened: After one unit landed, an older unit was checked against old main and refused.
lesson: Before every check and before landing, replay the unit's own commits onto the newest main.

title: Built on a source nobody had
what_happened: Work cited a research file that was not on the build machine, and was built anyway; the real run then showed the tool could not do the job.
lesson: Every cited source must exist; outside tools start with a reviewed research unit.

title: Stop cards woke the human at night
what_happened: Unit stop cards the orchestrator had already handled were pushed to the human's phone every hour.
lesson: Unit stop cards are the orchestrator's and are closed in the same step; only decisions are pushed.
